articles.title: What exactly is a Hi-Fi listening bar?
articles.description: Forget shouting over the music. At a Hi-Fi listening bar, you’re actually there to listen. Born in Japan and now popping up around the world, the concept puts vinyl, carefully tuned sound systems and intimate, low-lit spaces at the heart of a night out. At Saikindō in Abu Dhabi, the experience doesn’t stop at what comes through the speakers. Its cocktail menu takes songs apart and translates them into flavors you can drink. We spend a day there with Beverage Director and DJ Marco Corallo to find out why the world is tuning into listening bars, and what a favorite song might taste like in a glass.

articles.title: Midterms 2026: Can Democrats capitalise on Latino voter regret?
articles.description: In 2024, a 46 percent share of the Latino vote helped propel Donald Trump to the White House. But two years on, polls show that support has plummeted in spectacular fashion. Amid an immigration crackdown, violent ICE raids and the spiraling cost of living, some Latino voters say they regret having backed Trump at the ballot box. Now, as the midterms approach, can the Democrats capitalise on this sense of regret to win back what was once an essential part of their base? France 24 reporters Sam Ball and Barbara Gabel met with Latino voters and local Democrats in Phoenix, Arizona, to find out.
